run_quantization_oneshot: run W8A8 int8 quantization on a causal language model using llmcompressor oneshot
create_gptq_modifier: create a GPTQModifier recipe targeting Linear layers with W8A8 quantization scheme
build_calibration_dataset: build a tokenized calibration dataset from HuggingFace messages using a tokenizer
test_quantized_model: test a quantized model by generating text samples with dispatch_model and model.generate
save_quantized_model: save a quantized model and tokenizer to disk in compressed-tensors format
